title: Course-to-Capability Transformation
brief: Inventory extracted learning assets. Build course-source ledger. Define transformation pipeline (concept->lesson->skill->test). Attach provenance metadata. Quality gates: same scrutiny standard as hand-written assets.

units.title: Inventory all extracted learning assets from courses/tutorials/docs
Build course-source ledger: map each asset to its origin course/section/timestamp
Define transformation pipeline stages: concept -> lesson -> skill -> test
Attach provenance metadata to each transformed asset (source, version, confidence)
Define quality gates: same 3-agent scrutiny standard as hand-written assets
Validate pipeline end-to-end on 3 sample course extractions

exit_conditions: All extracted learning assets inventoried with provenance
Transformation pipeline defined and validated on 3 samples
Quality gates match hand-written asset scrutiny standard
